## RX-TX-Tracker v2.0.35

### Release summary
- Improved RX workflow: New RX creation now auto-prefills patient context when launched from patient timeline, patient list, or search.
- Import workflow enhancements: patient import now supports workflow step date columns and can auto-generate RX tracking entries.
- Added simulation support so QA can validate import behavior before applying real changes.

### What’s included
- Auto patient prefill for New RX modal
  - `views/rx-records.ejs`
  - `views/patient-timeline.ejs`
- Import workflow + simulation tooling
  - `controllers/importController.js`
  - `controllers/patientController.js`
  - `public/js/import.js`
  - `public/js/patients.js`
  - `scripts/simulate-patient-workflow-import.js`
  - `public/samples/import/*.csv`
  - `qa/qa-menu.bat`
  - `qa/web-ui.js`
  - `qa/web/public/index.html`
- Version/manual/changelog sync updates
  - `package.json`
  - `CHANGELOG.md`
  - `OPERATIONS_MANUAL.md`
  - `views/backoffice.ejs`
  - `views/import.ejs`
  - `public/js/backoffice-features.js`
  - `public/js/import.js`
  - `utils/globalSettings.js`
  - `controllers/adminController.js`
  - `controllers/snapshotController.js`

### QA check list
- [ ] Run `npm run qa:web` and execute `Run Import Workflow Simulation`.
- [ ] Validate 3 sample scenarios:
  - same service date for all steps
  - +1 day increment progression
  - service date inferred from earliest workflow date
- [ ] Rebuild artifact with `npm run build:exe`.
- [ ] Verify `server.exe --v` shows `Version: 2.0.35`.
- [ ] Upload `dist/server-update-2.0.35-deploy.zip` to production.
